newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goodyear news sidelines Singapore rubber players.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear news sidelines Singapore rubber players.

text.p: Many buyers in the Singapore rubber market were sidelined at the close of mostly thin trade on Monday because of the strike by the 13,000 workers of Goodyear Tire and Rubber Co, dealers said.
"The manufacturers here wanted to see what the impact of the strike would be," a dealer said.
"We expect the strike to disrupt production. But any support for prices will only be temporary because consumer buying is so weak," another trader said.
One dealer said there was no incentive for buyers to come in until the full impact of the strike is seen.
Traders said one major consumer asked around for offer prices of SIR20 rubber, but no deals were reported done.
"The two giants refrained from doing any kind of buying," one trader said. The only sizable deals were for more than 6,000 tonnes of RSS3 grade rubber, dealers said.
At around 0945 GMT, July RSS3 was seen at 109.00 U.S. cents a kg from 111.25 cents.
June RSS1 was seen at 156.25 Singapore cents (US$1.08) a kg from 158.75 cents.
June TSR20 was seen at 150.00 Singapore cents (US$1.04) a kg from 152.50 cents. -- (US$1-S$1.44) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
